name: Princess Kingdom
release_name: Complete English translation and drawing tool indicator
changes: Added complete English translations for all 600 challenge prompts, labels, questions and answers while preserving the Romanian source text.
Replaced artwork-baked Romanian category and action labels with live HTML labels that update immediately with the selected language.
Added a single localized statistics template and updated document language, progress labels, footer, adult help, celebration and update dialog text.
Added a clear selected visual state, aria-pressed state, and live selected-tool status for Pencil and Eraser.
Preserved local-only preferences and progress, the drawing board, and offline-first PWA behavior.
